from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single record of Diluted Earnings Per Share from one company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company that filed the report")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="The Diluted Earnings Per Share value; negative if it is a loss")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The date or period range for which this EPS was reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the reported value, e.g., USD")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[EPSRecord]
